summary: Core storage projection no longer echoes the Controller's queued request state, which made a pool master refuse VM creation when it had an SMB/NFS repository. API impact: none.

guide.reason: Documented VM creation workflow is unchanged; this removes a wrongful refusal.

api.reason: No contract, payload or journal format change; Core's placement observation omits request-state fields that the master's applied-storage list and member replication already omit.

roadmap.reason: Bug fix within existing placement scope.

state.reason: No new durable state; storage registrations remain in Core's managed journal.

verification.method: Regression unit test failed before and passes after; vmhost, agent, controller and protocol Go packages pass. Not deployed to or re-tested on the affected lab host.
